CustomField.formula: IF( AND( OR( Order.Account.PMC_SS_UnitofMeasure__r.Name = 'STN' , Order.Account.PMC_SS_UnitofMeasure__r.Name = 'MTN' ), TEXT( PMC_CPQ_UnitOfMeasure__c ) == Order.Account.PMC_SS_UnitofMeasure__r.Name), Quantity , IF( AND(TEXT( PMC_CPQ_UnitOfMeasure__c ) = 'MTN', Order.Account.PMC_SS_UnitofMeasure__r.Name = 'STN' ), Quantity * $CustomMetadata.PMC_SS_UOMConversionMapping__mdt.MTNtoSTN.PMC_SS_ConversionFactor__c, IF( AND(TEXT( PMC_CPQ_UnitOfMeasure__c ) = 'STN', Order.Account.PMC_SS_UnitofMeasure__r.Name = 'MTN' ), Quantity * $CustomMetadata.PMC_SS_UOMConversionMapping__mdt.STNtoMTN.PMC_SS_ConversionFactor__c , 0) ) )
